parameters.query: SELECT value AS task FROM enrichment_claim('research',2) value

nodes.name: Advance LinkedIn Collection
nodes.notes: Apify company lookup, role-filtered employee lookup and five recent posts. Global and organization opt-in, funded wallet or BYOK, shared account budget, $0.05 per run reservation, saved run IDs; ambiguous starts require review.

parameters.query: SELECT CASE WHEN $1::integer IS NULL OR $2::integer IS NULL THEN jsonb_build_object('error','INVALID_REQUEST') ELSE coalesce(enrichment_report($1,$2),jsonb_build_object('error','NOT_FOUND')) END AS result
SELECT CASE WHEN $1::jsonb IS NULL THEN jsonb_build_object('error','INVALID_REQUEST') ELSE enrichment_submit($1::jsonb,'linkedin') END AS result
SELECT CASE WHEN $1::jsonb IS NULL THEN jsonb_build_object('error','INVALID_REQUEST') ELSE enrichment_submit($1::jsonb,'campaign') END AS result
SELECT $1::bigint AS id,$2::text AS lease,enrichment_task_input($1,$2) AS input
SELECT CASE WHEN $3::boolean THEN enrichment_ai_gate($1,$2) ELSE jsonb_build_object('allowed',false,'reason','insufficient_evidence') END AS gate

nodes.name: Groq Evidence Analysis
nodes.notes: One bounded model call. Sources are untrusted data. No automatic HTTP retry; quota reservation is recorded before the call.

parameters.jsCode: const p=$('Prepare Evidence and AI Request').item.json;return {id:p.id,lease:p.lease,status:p.research?.status||'superseded',result:p.research?{...p.research,ai_research:{status:$json.gate.reason,requires_review:true}}:null};
